entries.title: Isaiah 33:1
segments: ¶Woe to you who plunder, though you [have] not [been] plundered; And you who deal treacherously, though they have not dealt treacherously with you! When you cease plundering, You will be plundered; When you make an end of dealing treacherously, They will deal treacherously with you.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:2
segments: O LORD, be gracious to us; We have waited for You. Be their arm every morning, Our salvation also in the time of trouble.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:3
segments: At the noise of the tumult the people shall flee; When You lift Yourself up, the nations shall be scattered;

entries.title: Isaiah 33:4
segments: And Your plunder shall be gathered [Like] the gathering of the caterpillar; As the running to and fro of locusts, He shall run upon them.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:5
segments: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:6
segments: Wisdom and knowledge will be the stability of your times, [And] the strength of salvation; The fear of the LORD [is] His treasure.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:7
segments: Surely their valiant ones shall cry outside, The ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:8
segments: The highways lie waste, The traveling man ceases. He has broken the covenant, He has despised the cities, He regards no man.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:9
segments: The earth mourns [and] languishes, Lebanon is shamed [and] shriveled; Sharon is like a wilderness, And Bashan and Carmel shake off [their fruits].

entries.title: Isaiah 33:10
segments: "Now I will rise," says the LORD; "Now I will be exalted, Now I will lift Myself up.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:11
segments: You shall conceive chaff, You shall bring forth stubble; Your breath, [as] fire, shall devour you.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:12
segments: And the people shall be [like] the burnings of lime; [Like] thorns cut up they shall be burned in the fire.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:13
segments: ¶Hear, you [who are] afar off, what I have done; And you [who are] near, acknowledge My might."

entries.title: Isaiah 33:14
segments: The sinners in Zion are afraid; Fearfulness has seized the hypocrites: "Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? Who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?"

entries.title: Isaiah 33:15
segments: He who walks righteously and speaks uprightly, He who despises the gain of oppressions, Who gestures with his hands, refusing bribes, Who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, And shuts his eyes from seeing evil:

entries.title: Isaiah 33:16
segments: He will dwell on high; His place of defense [will be] the fortress of rocks; Bread will be given him, His water [will be] sure.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:17
segments: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty; They will see the land that is very far off.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:18
segments: Your heart will meditate on terror: "Where [is] the scribe? Where [is] he who weighs? Where [is] he who counts the towers?"

entries.title: Isaiah 33:19
segments: You will not see a fierce people, A people of obscure speech, beyond perception, Of a stammering tongue [that you] cannot understand.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:20
segments: Look upon Zion, the city of our appointed feasts; Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet home, A tabernacle [that] will not be taken down; Not one of its stakes will ever be removed, Nor will any of its cords be broken.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:21
segments: But there the majestic LORD [will be] for us A place of broad rivers [and] streams, In which no galley with oars will sail, Nor majestic ships pass by

entries.title: Isaiah 33:22
segments: (For the LORD [is] our Judge, The LORD [is] our Lawgiver, The LORD [is] our King; He will save us);

entries.title: Isaiah 33:23
segments: Your tackle is loosed, They could not strengthen their mast, They could not spread the sail. Then the prey of great plunder is divided; The lame take the prey.

entries.title: Isaiah 33:24
segments: And the inhabitant will not say, "I am sick"; The people who dwell in it [will be] forgiven [their] iniquity.
